anchor: Plan v10 Track SS — Australian state payroll tax variation. CIT 30% federal (25% small business). Payroll tax is state-level — varies materially from 4.75% (Queensland) to 6.85% (NSW) above thresholds.
convention: payroll_tax_rate is top state payroll rate. payroll_threshold is the annual payroll exemption (no tax below). Land tax varies separately by state.

default_country_rate.notes: Federal CIT 30% (25% for SMEs with turnover < AUD 50M).

AU-NSW.name: New South Wales
AU-NSW.notes: Standard 5.45% above AUD 1.2M; mental health levy +0.5% above AUD 10M.

AU-VIC.name: Victoria
AU-VIC.notes: Standard 4.85% above AUD 900K. Regional rate 1.2125% in qualifying areas.

AU-QLD.name: Queensland
AU-QLD.notes: Standard 4.75% above AUD 1.3M; mental health levy 0.25% above AUD 10M.

AU-WA.name: Western Australia
AU-WA.notes: 5.5% above AUD 1M; diminishing threshold up to AUD 7.5M.

AU-SA.name: South Australia
AU-SA.notes: 4.95% above AUD 1.5M (variable 0-4.95% in the AUD 1.5M-1.7M range).
